metadata.description: Sega System 32 for the Analogue Pocket. One core for Golden Axe: The Revenge of Death Adder, Spider-Man: The Videogame and SegaSonic The Hedgehog, in their World, US and Japanese versions, chosen by a Game file at launch. Saved high scores for Spider-Man and SegaSonic, multiplayer with the Analogue Dock, pauses while the Pocket menu is open. Needs your own ROM files (not included).
metadata.author: mmnbass
